counselling.title: What happens in the room
counselling.description: Counselling isn't lying on a couch while someone analyzes you. It's a conversation with a trained person who is fully on your side, helping you understand what's going on and what to do about it.

items.title: You're heard without being fixed
items.description: No advice you didn't ask for. No rushing to solutions. Just space for what you're carrying.

items.title: Everything is confidential
items.description: What you share stays in the room. Even your family or employer won't know unless you tell them.

items.title: You leave with real tools
items.description: Techniques you can use between sessions. Ways of thinking that genuinely help when anxiety rises.

items.title: You set the pace, always
items.description: Come weekly, monthly, or just once. Stop whenever you want. There's no 'right' way to do this.
